templateId.description: Select which template you'd like to used for this transaction.

mimeType.description: If "Template" is specified, this will be ignored..

content.description: To merge in variables, you must use the syntax [[Tx.VariableData.VariableName]] (ex. Variable name is FirstName, merge syntax would be [[Tx.VariableData.FirstName]]) If "Template" is specified, this will be ignored.

tarvent_get_custom_event.name: tarvent_get_custom_event
tarvent_get_custom_event.description: Finds a custom event by name.

name.description: Find a custom event by searching using its name.

aiMetadata.description: Searches the custom event definitions in a Tarvent account, optionally filtered by name; leaving the name empty returns all custom events. Use to look up a custom event or its ID before generating it for a contact. Idempotent read-only lookup.

tarvent_get_journey.name: tarvent_get_journey
tarvent_get_journey.description: Finds a journey by name, status or tags.

name.description: Find a journey by searching using its name.

tags.description: Find a journey by searching using its tags. To search using multiple tags, separate the tags with a comma.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Tarvent automation journeys, optionally filtered by name, comma-separated tags, and/or run status (running or not running); leaving the filters empty returns all journeys.
